Labor Listing Test Suite

The feature suite exercises the public labor-listing endpoint through Django REST Framework’s in-process test client and an isolated pytest-django database. Six test functions expand into sixteen cases through parameterization.

Fixtures

Reusable pytest fixtures for labor-listing API tests.

Pytest discovers this module automatically and injects fixtures into test functions by matching their argument names.

tests.conftest.api_client()[source]

Return an unauthenticated Django REST Framework test client.

The listing endpoint is public, so the client deliberately has no user credentials.

Returns:

Client used to send in-process requests to the Django API.

Return type:

rest_framework.test.APIClient

tests.conftest.labor_factory(db)[source]

Return a factory that creates valid, customizable labor records.

The factory supplies deterministic defaults and accepts keyword overrides for fields relevant to an individual test. The db fixture enables access to pytest-django’s isolated test database.

Parameters:

db – Pytest-django fixture that enables database access.

Returns:

Callable that creates and returns a Labor instance.

Return type:

collections.abc.Callable

tests.conftest.listing_labors(labor_factory)[source]

Create the deterministic records used by listing feature tests.

The returned mapping contains an electrician, cleaner, and plumber with distinct search fields, wages, ratings, and review counts. Those differences make filtering and ordering assertions unambiguous.

Parameters:

labor_factory – Fixture that creates valid labor records.

Returns:

Records keyed by electrician, cleaner, and plumber.

Return type:

dict[str, apps.labor.models.Labor]

Feature Tests

Feature tests for the public labor-listing API.

The suite verifies the response contract, supported searches and filters, deterministic sorting, pagination metadata, and query-parameter validation. Parameterized inputs expand the six test functions into sixteen test cases.

tests.test_labor_listings._result_ids(response)[source]

Extract ordered labor IDs from a paginated API response.

Parameters:

response – Django REST Framework response returned by APIClient.

Returns:

Labor primary keys in their serialized response order.

Return type:

list[int]

tests.test_labor_listings.test_combined_filters_return_only_matching_labor(api_client, listing_labors)[source]

Verify search, category, rating, and wage filters combine with AND.

Parameters:

  • api_client – Unauthenticated REST Framework test client.

  • listing_labors – Mapping of deterministic labor records.

tests.test_labor_listings.test_invalid_listing_parameters_return_field_errors(api_client, parameters, error_field)[source]

Verify malformed listing parameters return field-specific HTTP 400s.

Parameters:

  • api_client – Unauthenticated REST Framework test client.

  • parameters (dict) – Invalid query parameters for this test case.

  • error_field (str) – Response field expected to describe the error.

tests.test_labor_listings.test_listing_is_public_and_returns_the_expected_contract(api_client, listing_labors)[source]

Verify anonymous access, response fields, and default ordering.

Parameters:

  • api_client – Unauthenticated REST Framework test client.

  • listing_labors – Deterministic labor records for list assertions.

tests.test_labor_listings.test_pagination_returns_requested_page_and_navigation_links(api_client, labor_factory)[source]

Verify page slicing, total count, and next/previous navigation links.

Parameters:

  • api_client – Unauthenticated REST Framework test client.

  • labor_factory – Factory used to create a multi-page dataset.

tests.test_labor_listings.test_search_matches_supported_labor_fields(api_client, listing_labors, query, expected_key)[source]

Verify search matching by name, profession, category, and location.

Parameters:

  • api_client – Unauthenticated REST Framework test client.

  • listing_labors – Mapping of deterministic labor records.

  • query (str) – Search value supplied by the parameterized case.

  • expected_key (str) – Mapping key for the expected labor record.

tests.test_labor_listings.test_sort_options_return_deterministic_order(api_client, listing_labors, sort, expected_keys)[source]

Verify every supported sort option returns the complete expected order.

Parameters:

  • api_client – Unauthenticated REST Framework test client.

  • listing_labors – Mapping of deterministic labor records.

  • sort (str) – API sorting option supplied by the parameterized case.

  • expected_keys (list[str]) – Labor keys in their expected order.
